<!-- pr-reviewer: b3c1c46c5c65e57582725f5a2b12f7b6892b686b -->
Needs changes before merge: three findings below.

This is a safety review. The change affects bore toolpaths and posted G-code. I read the whole diff and the current upstream laws.

The default Plunge entry keeps the earlier file representation. The new motion and project tests pass.

**Local results**

I tested a clean trial merge with `upstream/main` at `a6cd476fde7c19e238bc1a02b6ab1264859660f6`.
The local merge is `0835b417c0938222493ba6b95c0f230c946ec4c8`. Its first parent is this PR head.

- `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=4 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 727 steps passed; zero failures; zero stalls.
- Motion `bore_ramp_angle`: 4 passed. App `bore_entry`: 7 passed.
- UI library suite, from `crates/ui`: 1,542 passed; 8 ignored. All eight selected UI integration suites passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 4 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light --only 'motion light' --only 'app light'`: all 11 tests passed across five suites. Each suite compiled its required release target. I omitted the broad release prebuild.

**Extra suites run**

These suites ran by name in the quick gate:

| App suite | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `example_catalog` | 39 passed; 4 ignored |
| `example_catalog_adaptive` | 1 passed |
| `example_catalog_edge_work` | 1 passed |
| `golden_cl` | 34 passed |
| `solid_law_goldens` | 7 passed |
| `mach4_builtin` | 2 passed |

No fixture or importer changed. The additional kernel STEP suites were therefore not required.
Full heavy lanes were not run. Current upstream **Heavy lanes at review** does not require them for this P6 issue.

**Mutations and goldens**

The body supplies no mutation record. I tested two independent mutations in isolated source copies under `/tmp`.
Both failed `a_bore_barely_wider_than_its_cutter_descends_within_the_angle_cap` at the `Ramp Ø3.2: it ramps` assertion:

1. Restore `MAX_BORE_ZIG_LEGS` to 64: expected failure detected.
2. Force `Entry3D::Plunge` in the bore motion entry builder: expected failure detected.

The unchanged control passed all four tests before the mutations. The restored control passed all four after a rebuild.
No mutation changed the review worktree.

Goldens moved: none. No recorded `.nc`, `.cl`, or catalog program changed in this PR.

**Requested before merge**

1. **Class: validation at command creation.** `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:2806` rejects `Arc` only during generation. The shared Bore parameter validation does not reject it. Thus an unsupported entry can enter the document through operation commands. This breaks **Validate early** in the current upstream laws. Add one shared allow-list for Plunge, Ramp, and Helix at command creation. Test the named refusal through both `CreateOperation` and `EditOperationParams`. Keep the generator check as a second check.

2. **Class: structural UI coverage.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/lead_page.rs:92` adds an Entry group without structural tests. The UI test changes only add the default field to existing fixtures. Current upstream **Pixel snapshots are release-lane** requires structural assertions for UI changes. Add tests for the three choices, their conditional fields, and the Apply command with undo and redo. Do not change snapshot PNGs.

3. **Class: UI review evidence.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/holes_page.rs:134` changes the Bore pane, but the PR body has no before/after screenshots. Add real screenshots and link them from the body. Store them only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit screenshots or review evidence to this PR branch.

I left the labels, draft state, and title unchanged as requested. The review worktree and branch remain in place.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

I refreshed this branch against main. The new head is a7743af5c. It merges `origin/main` at `97a676e5c`. No force-push.

What the refresh changed:
- Main added `picks` to the Bore in the same places as `entry` of this PR. The conflicts were in `operation/kinds.rs`, `operation/params/holes.rs`, `operation/types/params.rs`, `project/params.rs`, `project/params_impl.rs` and `ui/src/egui_app/holes_page.rs`. Each one keeps both sides.
- An earlier merge of main on this branch resolved `lead_page.rs`. It keeps main's `entry_group` (with the `start` argument) and the Bore's own `bore_entry_group`.
- The merges change no logic of this PR.

Quick gate on the new head: 1211 steps, 3 failed, 0 stalled. Clippy passed. The failed steps are:
- `sinumerik_810m_post` and `catalog_render`. They were also red on an unchanged main in my Windows checkout, at an earlier main.
- `mcp_live` (`a_client_that_keeps_talking_is_never_dropped_as_idle`): the connection was reset (OS error 10054). Run alone three times, it passed two times and failed one time. This PR touches no MCP file. I have not run it on an unchanged main.

The new head waits for a review.
